model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the F1 score and the leakage rate for three different methods: Teacher, Self-Training, and PST. The x-axis represents the leakage rate, labeled as "漏标率", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.585, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis represents the F1 score, with a linear scale ranging from 52.5 to 72.5, and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The Teacher method is represented by a red line with star markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 71.0 on the y-axis when the leakage rate is 0 and decreasing to around 53.0 when the leakage rate is 0.585, with a notable drop between 0.4 and 0.5. The Self-Training method is depicted by a blue line with square markers and a solid line style, beginning at around 70.5 on the y-axis when the leakage rate is 0 and declining to approximately 52.5 when the leakage rate is 0.585, also showing a significant decrease between 0.4 and 0.5. The PST method is shown as a green line with circular markers and a solid line style, starting at about 72.0 on the y-axis when the leakage rate is 0 and decreasing to around 62.0 when the leakage rate is 0.585, with a relatively steady decline across the x-axis range.
